reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports that 0.1 at.% C does not affect ambient-pressure phases and that high-P/T conditions form stable carbides which may improve mechanical performance. However, the study used high pressure (6 GPa) plus 809 °C, not the atmospheric-pressure, 800–1200 °C jet-turbine conditions claimed in the hypothesis, so the extrapolation to service conditions is unsupported.
